name: factext
parts: orders.o_clerk: U32 codes of dictionary indices
orders.o_clerk: U64 group bases of dictionary indices

layout.summary: The long, rarely used text columns of lineitem (l_comment) and orders (o_clerk as a sorted dictionary of 100000 entries with U32 codes, o_comment as text), in canonical row order (stored row j = source row j), with uniform 65536-row groups.
layout.units: Integers exact: bigint as integers, numeric(15,2) as coefficients of scale 2 (value = coefficient / 100), dates as days since 2000-01-01 (Val::Date); frame-of-reference value = group base (I64, or U64 for dictionary indices and row positions) + unsigned code (U8/U16/U32) of the row; text offsets are byte offsets (U64, from 0) into the U8 byte part; group starts and row positions are stored-row indices; block size 65536 rows.
